description.value:
Trigger You are about to attempt a Recall Knowledge check

Requirements Declared Signal

Cost 1 Bandwidth

Traits Paradise-Touched

You spend 1 Bandwidth. Do not roll the check; treat the d20 as a 15 and apply all your modifiers to it normally. This must be declared before the check is attempted, and it must be declared Signal, so a failure costs you 2 force damage per level and 1 Signal Drift as always.

cinderfall.incomplete: Unbuildable: the 1-Bandwidth cost is not enforced or deducted (no `SpecialResource` for Bandwidth exists anywhere in the corpus), and the mandatory Signal declaration's failure consequence (2 force damage/level + 1 Drift if the substituted 15 still fails the check) is not modeled (the class's Signal/Static core mechanic has no rule-element analog, and the Signal Drift track has no counter representation) -- a player could toggle this on for free and face no in-sheet penalty on failure.
